notes: Each event is a resolved match-winner market with official WTA source evidence for a game-changing upset/comeback.

Moment estimates are scheduled gameStartTime plus the published match duration, so they mark the approximate final-match-point time; article sources do not timestamp the specific comeback break or match point.
The API fidelity=1 request returned raw public prices at approximately one-minute intervals; actual points may be sparse during low-trading periods.
Gamma total volume was stored as totalVolume, not as 24-hour volume; volume24h is null because the historical API snapshot does not supply a 24-hour breakdown.

market.title: Singapore Open: Tatiana Prozorova vs Alexandra Eala

events.momentBasis: Prozorova came from a set and 4-2 down to defeat third seed Alexandra Eala 4-6, 7-5, 6-3. Estimated turning-point timestamp uses the scheduled start plus WTA-reported 3h09 match duration; the narrative describes the comeback, but does not time the 4-2-to-5-5 service break.

market.title: Wuhan Tennis Open: Hanyu Guo vs Sorana Cirstea

events.momentBasis: Guo upset No. 16 Cirstea 1-6, 7-6(6), 7-5, after trailing a set and 4-0 and saving three match points. Estimated decisive timestamp uses scheduled start plus WTA-reported 2h41 match duration; the report gives the scoreline and match length but not the exact point timestamp.
